notes.text: The opening says bien parallèles and qualifies the statement with “à cela près qu’il faut exiger”. A cancelled first formulation precedes the inserted condition (**), which continues into the left margin. The independent slanted note connects distinct a,b with distinct decomposition symbols. Its verb and label remain uncertain. The closing non parallèles drew attention to the opening bien; the crop supports retaining both written phrases.

The construction paragraph introduces an arbre topologique represented by the pair (underlined Gamma,S). The small inserted label esp. top. points toward the underlined Gamma. It describes choosing a point on each edge and writes the barycentric-subdivision pair, with S amalg A-prime underbraced and labelled S-star. The cancelled original first letter is read A, followed in the transcription convention by its live replacement script X.

After that pair the relation sign has an inner diagonal return, so membership precedes inclusion in the retained alternatives. The mathematical role of A-prime prompted the crop but did not remove that stroke. The following words are the abbreviation corr, biunivoque with an uncertain cancelled prefix, and donnée; H’s correspondance and canonique are not substituted.

The bracketed NB states that the added vertices have degree 2 and gives the wording “une exactement des deux extrémités appartient à” A-prime, followed by “l’autre à” S. It calls this “une description complète”. The object after arête de is script X-star; a possible overwritten underlined Gamma is retained with its identity and cancellation state both uncertain. No truth claim about the characterization is certified here.

The last paragraph describes the cut at a-prime, two connected components, their closures, a binary decomposition and its equator {a-prime}. The plural s of point is cancelled, a-prime is inserted above the line, and the ending after coupe and the high mark on Gamma are cancelled but partly obscured. The article’s final s remains live|cancelled; its state is not supplied from agreement with those neighbouring revisions.

The final comparison retains uncertainty in the second prime count and in the abbreviated modifier before non parallèles. The main crop separates str and a raised crossed t; stric and strict with a raised t remain alternatives. The extra opening double quotes before équateur are preserved without a supplied closing pair. These are visual reading decisions, without proof or computation checks.

The sheet has no observed title, date, authorial question mark or explicit instruction to verify a step. Its light pencil 28 is recorded as archive numbering. There is no drawing or arrow diagram. H’s note explicitly maps handwritten underlined Gamma to bold Gamma: that declared mapping is excluded from collation, while its final plain NB Gamma loses a visible underline and receives a row.
